title: Freeze Source Provenance Before Long Shot Pattern Experiments
body:
## Problem

Export-time file hashes can identify edited files rather than code loaded at the beginning of a long simulation.

## Acceptance Criteria

Capture source and native hashes before simulation, retain a source snapshot or exact commit, link the run-start receipt, and reject unaccounted scientific-source drift. Apply this to standalone CLI/GUI analysis as well as the matrix. Ensure concurrent workers own disjoint outputs and skip only verified complete bundles.

## Validation

tests/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/test_matrix.py and standalone provenance regression tests; run-start snapshots, source-drift rejection, verified completion/resume manifests.

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
